reasoning_content: The curl output to /workspace/.home.html failed with exit code 23 (write error — the web container is running as www and can't write to /workspace as root-owned... actually /workspace is owned by dev, and www can't write there). Let's output to /tmp inside the container. Also, let's properly fix the drush ev quoting issue too.

action.command:
cd /workspace
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec sh -c 'curl -sL http://localhost/ -o /tmp/home.html; grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/home.html | head -1; grep -c "openculturas" /tmp/home.html'
echo "=== drush core:version ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush core:version 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=== node count ==="
cat > /tmp/nodes.php <<'EOF'
echo 'node count: ' . \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('node')->getQuery()->count()->execute();
EOF
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush php-eval "$(cat /tmp/nodes.php)" 2>&1 | tail -2

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec sh -c 'curl -sL http://localhost/ -o /tmp/home.html; grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/home.html | head -1; grep -c "openculturas" /tmp/home.html'
echo "=== drush core:version ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush core:version 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=== node count ==="
cat > /tmp/nodes.php <<'EOF'
echo 'node count: ' . \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('node')->getQuery()->count()->execute();
EOF
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush php-eval "$(cat /tmp/nodes.php)" 2>&1 | tail -2", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Verify homepage and content properly"}
